isomorphisms.name: Godel-Tarski Meta-Level to Divine Ground
isomorphisms.chi_law: The meta-level truth predicate (Tarski) maps to God as the self-grounding meta-level; the unprovable true sentence (Godel) maps to the necessity of a transcendent ground.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: God as the meta-level ground of truth, identified with 'I AM' (Exodus 3:14).
isomorphisms.prediction: Any formal system that denies a meta-level ground will produce a Godel sentence that cannot be resolved within the system, leading to inconsistency or incompleteness.
mapped_text_steps: Godel's First Incompleteness Theorem: consistent system F cannot prove G_F
Tarski's Undefinability Theorem: truth predicate for L must be in meta-language L'
Russell's Paradox: naive self-reference leads to contradiction
The regress of meta-languages must terminate
The termination point is identified as God: 'I AM'
Q0 posture: humility as prerequisite to inquiry
Pride (Q0 = pride) leads to encountering Godel sentence and halting or lying
The meta-level slot is not empty
Being and truth collapsed into one self-referential declaration
preserved_transitions: From unprovable truth to meta-level ground
From infinite regress to termination in self-grounding entity
From formal system limitation to prerequisite posture (humility)
missing_transitions: The exact mechanism by which 'I AM' avoids Russell-type paradox is deferred to Page 03
isomorphisms.notes: The mapping is structurally tight: the role of the meta-level in logic maps directly to the role of God as ground. The one-to-one correspondence holds at the level of roles (truth predicate vs. divine attribute), constraints (incompleteness vs. necessity of ground), and dynamics (regress termination). The only missing piece is the detailed typing resolution, which is promised elsewhere.

isomorphisms.name: Q0 Posture to Epistemic Foundation
isomorphisms.chi_law: The foundational epistemic posture (humility vs. pride) maps to the choice of starting assumptions in any formal system, determining whether the system acknowledges its own ground.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: The 7Q Classifier's Q0 as the operational prerequisite for inquiry.
isomorphisms.prediction: Systems that begin with pride (self-sufficiency) will produce internal contradictions or halt when confronted with their own Godel sentence.

isomorphisms.name: Russell's Paradox to Typed Self-Reference Resolution
isomorphisms.chi_law: Russell's paradox (naive set theory) maps to the necessity of typed self-reference in theology; the resolution (type theory) maps to the claim that 'I AM' is typed at the operation level, not the object level.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: The claim that 'I AM' avoids Russell-type paradox due to proper typing.
isomorphisms.prediction: The detailed typing resolution (Page 03) will show that 'I AM' is a meta-level operation, not an object-level term, thus avoiding paradox.
